raw_segments.text: Do you acknowledge that the power of looking into futurity and seeing things that are not,
as if they were, is an attribute of the creator?
And should he, by an impression on the minds of his creatures, think fit to impart to them
some event hid in the shades of time, yet unborn, to whom would the secret be revealed
The opinion of ages will answer this question to Reverend Old Men, to people distinguished
